description: Displays a circular loading indicator to indicate progress or loading state.

animating.description: Whether to show the indicator (true) or hide it (false).

color.default: null (system accent color on Android), '#999999' on iOS
color.description: The foreground color of the spinner.

hidesWhenStopped.description: Whether the indicator should hide when not animating.

ref.description: A ref setter that will be assigned an element node when mounted.
